kebab_example: aliyun vs modify-template --id 32300000998-cn-qingdao --name '录制模板' --description '录制模板' --biz-region cn-qingdao --oss-bucket bucketname --oss-endpoint oss-cn-qingdao.aliyuncs.com --oss-file-prefix oss-prefix --trigger auto --interval 3600 --retention 3 --file-format hls --jpg-overwrite osspath/snapshot/_AppName_/_StreamName_.jpg --jpg-sequence osspath/snapshot/_AppName_/_StreamName_/_UnixTimestamp_.jpg --jpg-on-demand osspath/snapshot/_AppName_/_StreamName_/_UnixTimestamp_ondemand.jpg --mp4 osspath/record/_StreamName_/_EscapedStartTime_EscapedEndTime --flv osspath/record/_StreamName_/_EscapedStartTime_EscapedEndTime --hls-m3u8 osspath/record/_StreamName_/_EscapedStartTime_EscapedEndTime --hls-ts osspath/record/_StreamName_/_UnixTimestamp_Sequence --callback http://example.com/callback --trans-configs-json Fps_:25,_Gop_:50,_Height_:720,_VideoCodec_:_h264_,_Width_:1280,_Name_:_sd_,_VideoBitrate_:800 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the template
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the template
parameters.help_zh: 模板描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region where the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket is located
parameters.help_zh: OSS所属区域，即服务中心
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: OSS的Bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: OSS的域名
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the OSS file
parameters.help_zh: OSS文件前缀
parameters.name: oss_file_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the template. The default value is auto. Valid values:

- auto (automatic)

- ondemand (on-demand)
parameters.help_zh:
模板触发类型，默认auto。取值：
- auto（自动）
- ondemand（按需）
parameters.name: trigger

parameters.help_en: The operation interval, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 操作周期，单位秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The retention period for time shifting, in days
parameters.help_zh: 时移保存周期，单位：天
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
The file format for storage. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

- mp4

- flv

- hls

> Recording in FLV and MP4 formats is not supported in the China (Qingdao) region
parameters.help_zh:
存储文件格式，多值用逗号分隔。取值：
- mp4
- flv
- hls
> 青岛单元暂不支持flv、mp4录制
parameters.name: file_format
jpg_overwrite

parameters.help_en:
The storage path for JPG files. This path is used for sequence snapshots.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence}
parameters.help_zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于序列截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
parameters.name: jpg_sequence

parameters.help_en:
The storage path for JPG files. This path is used for on-demand snapshots.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence}
parameters.help_zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于按需截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
parameters.name: jpg_on_demand
mp4

parameters.help_en: The storage path for FLV files. For information about the format, see the description of the Mp4 parameter
parameters.help_zh: FLV的存储路径。格式参考Mp4说明
parameters.name: flv

parameters.help_en: The storage path for HLS M3U8 files. For information about the format, see the description of the Mp4 parameter
parameters.help_zh: HLS的存储路径，m3u8文件。格式参考Mp4说明
parameters.name: hls_m3u8

parameters.help_en:
The storage path for HLS TS files.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables
parameters.name: hls_ts

parameters.help_en: The callback URL that is used after the template is executed
parameters.help_zh: 模板执行后的回调
parameters.name: callback

parameters.help_en: An array of transcoding configurations of the TransConfig type, in a JSON-formatted string
parameters.help_zh: 转码配置TransConfig类型的数组，JSON格式字符串
parameters.name: trans_configs_json
